name: field-diff-table
title: Field diff table
description: What changed on a record: each field's old and new value side by side, with added and removed values marked in words. For audit trails and approvals.
docs: The table is a Server Component, so `formatters` can be plain functions keyed by field name; they are called only for values that are not empty. Only the "Show full text" and "unchanged fields" buttons run in the browser. Leave `kind` out and it follows from `before` and `after`: an empty value (undefined, null, "" or []) reads "was empty" or "removed", while 0 and false are values. Dates are `Date` objects drawn with `locale` and `timeZone`; strings are shown as given. A field name is tidied into a label ("due_date" becomes "Due date"); pass `label` for anything else, such as "SKU".
